note: Concept register only. Everything here is provisional and concept-local; canon is adjudicated by the implementation audit, never minted here.

plan_owner_impacts.evidence: Chapters navigation model: a persistent right-edge chapter tab spine (Home + the 12 canonical categories, numbered 01-12) plus layered page depth — deeper navigation pushes a sheet whose under-layer stays visible as a slim named edge on the leading side; clicking an edge peels back. The spec would need to define the layer-stack state machine (plan -> reconcile -> push/peel), the under-edge affordance, and the narrow transformation (spine becomes a top strip, layers become full-width push).

Escape ladder implemented exactly as popup -> search dropdown -> open detail drawer -> manager object detail -> one layer out -> stop at Home; tab switches inside a manager replace the history entry (scrollspy semantics) so browser Back always returns one Settings level.

The rev-2 canonical deep-link probe id system.health.diagnostics-verbosity does not exist in the 828-row PM2_INVENTORY (system.health.* has platform-diagnostics, doctor-summary, telemetry, …). The concept answers the stale id with an honest 'not in this project's settings' chapter notice; harness probes should standardize on system.health.platform-diagnostics.

legacyScope metadata is consumed strictly as history: it renders only inside the row Details drawer as prose ('Before the project-only model this lived at … scope'), never as a scope control — matching the project-only statute.

Provider manager renders the shared answer-block verbatim: connected state, account in use, what is included, on-exhaust behavior, models, setup/repair — with accounts/models/limits/routing/installs/setup/activity/advanced as manager-local tabs on the object page. Unknown-owner Ollama exposes a disabled update action whose refusal reason is rendered in DOM text, not hover-only.

Stepwise copy as stacked step sheets (the concept's layer metaphor inside the transaction): source -> categories -> preview -> confirm/apply. One-time language throughout; credential references copied by reference with the shared no-secret note; restore point staged before writes; rollback restores exactly and reports honestly.

A bare op handle returned by a manager action (PM2.states.op created but not staged by the shared module) is driven by the concept through an honest queued -> running -> done indeterminate sequence; determinate bars appear only when the op event carries completed/total (copy apply does).

settings_schema_impacts.note: Rows render seven states (normal/managed/unavailable/error/restart-required/reconnect-required/changed-elsewhere) from resolveRow + pm2-states rowStates; the schema needs these as first-class row states, not booleans.

Fixture overlays announce themselves via data.notices (pm2-fx-*); the concept surfaces those in the Home attention list. A real schema needs a typed notice -> destination contract (target.settingId / managerId / cat plus a primary act verb).

list/keyvalue rows carry structured values with no editing grammar in the shared modules; the concept shows honest summaries + drawer contents. Schema should either define an editing grammar or mark them manager-owned.

schema_event_storage_impacts.note: Only pm.settingsConcepts.fable.c09-chapters.* (shell prefs via PMShell + store scenario/fixture pins). No other keys written.
Subscribes to scenario/fixtures/stress/change/value/value-error/op/receipt/copy; re-renders the top layer via one rAF-coalesced rebuild and marks under layers stale (re-rendered on peel).
Search state rides in #/search/<query> via replaceState while typing, so Back from a landing restores the query and its results without polluting history.

slint_port_impacts.note: Layers are plain data ({key, kind, state}); render is a reconcile over the plan. Maps to a Slint stack of components with x-translate transitions; the settle pattern uses fixed timers, never transitionend.
All Settings windows 828+2000 rows over fixed 56px row height with top/bottom spacers — direct ListView equivalent; only ~19 rows live in the DOM.
Bounded (limit 40), synchronous latest-request-wins queries, keyboard state (active index) held in a plain struct.
Collision handling is measured once at open (flip up near the bottom edge, clamp horizontally) — portable to Slint Popup positioning.
Zero backdrop-filter layers in concept CSS (the shell titlebar owns the single allowed one); shadows are theme tokens only.
All transitions ride the three shell kill switches; push/peel become instant swaps with under-edges still rendered; the locator becomes a single opacity step.

unresolved_questions: Should the Home attention list cap at 4 when fixture notices are active, or is exceeding the baseline cap acceptable for additive test overlays (current behavior)?
Tab switches inside a manager use replaceState; should object selection ALSO replace instead of push, or is detail-as-history-entry (current) the right Back grammar?
The stale diagnostics-verbosity id: mint the inventory row or retire the probe — which way does the census go?

store.attention() keys off the persisted scenario key and ignores URL-applied scenarios; concepts each re-derive the list from PM2.states.activeScenario(). Should pm2-store expose an active-scenario-aware attention()?
fx.import-conflict references two setting ids that are not inventory rows; should fixtures be constrained to real ids?
